classes.name: Élections législatives (Chambre des Députés)
classes.finest_note: Published by commune (with a separate postal count per constituency since 2018); polling-station counts are not published.
classes.note: 60 deputies in four constituencies (Sud 23, Centre 21, Nord 9, Est 7), open-list PR with panachage and the Hagenbach-Bischoff quota; voting compulsory. From 1919 to 1954 half the Chamber was renewed every three years, alternately in Sud and Est and in Centre and Nord.

cadence.administered_by: Gouvernement (Ministère d'État) and the principal bureaus of the constituencies

classes.name: Élections européennes
classes.finest_note: One national constituency; results published by constituency and commune.
classes.note: Six members elected in one national constituency by open-list PR (Hagenbach-Bischoff), six votes per voter with panachage; held with the legislative elections until 2009.

classes.name: Référendums nationaux
classes.finest_note: One national constituency; the 2015 results are published by constituency and commune.
classes.note: Referendums under the law of 4 February 2005 (constitutional and consultative referendums, old Constitution arts. 51 and 114); earlier ones in 1919 and 1937 were called by special laws. Voting compulsory.

classes.name: Élections censitaires à la Chambre des Députés (1848-1918)
classes.name_en: Chamber of Deputies elections under property suffrage (1848-1918)
classes.note: Direct census suffrage by canton with majority voting and partial renewals (indirect again briefly from 1856, direct from 1860); 51 deputies in 1848, 31 from 1857, 40 from 1868, 53 by 1916. Includes the Chamber with constituent powers elected on 28 July and 4 August 1918.

dates.quote: C'est le 28 septembre qu'ont lieu les premières élections pour la Chambre des députés
dates.note: First Chamber under the Constitution of 1848.
Partial renewals and by-elections by canton under property suffrage; not yet counted from the Mémorial and the Chamber's compte rendu.

dates.quote: Le 28 juillet et le 4 août 1918 ont lieu les élections pour une nouvelle Chambre chargée de procéder à la révision de la Constitution
dates.note: Two rounds (28 July and 4 August 1918); 53 deputies.

classes.name: Assemblée des États (1841-1848, 1856-1868)
classes.note: 34-member consultative assembly under the 1841 charter, elected by two-stage census suffrage with half renewed every three years; restored as the legislature under the 1856 charter until the 1868 Constitution.

dates.note: Elections to the Assembly of Estates; not yet counted from the Mémorial.

classes.name: Assemblée constituante (1848)
classes.note: Elected by two-stage census suffrage in spring 1848; it adopted the Constitution of 1848, which introduced direct census suffrage.

dates.note: Two-stage election; date and constituency count not yet read from an official text.

classes.name: Élections communales
classes.finest_note: Each commune is one constituency (a few merged communes vote in electoral sections); published by commune only.
classes.note: Councils of 7 to 19 members (27 in Luxembourg City) by population, every six years; plurality block vote in communes under 3,000 inhabitants and open-list PR (Hagenbach-Bischoff) above. EU and other foreign residents may register. The mayor and aldermen are appointed, not elected.

cadence.administered_by: Communes, under the Ministère des Affaires intérieures and the Ministère d'État
cadence.locator: https://elections.public.lu/fr/systeme-electoral/communales-mode-emploi/principes.html (Les élections communales ont lieu tous les 6 ans)
cadence.vacancy_rule: Proportional communes fill a vacancy from the same list; plurality communes hold a by-election (loi électorale)

cadence.administered_by: Communes, under the Ministère de l'Intérieur

classes.name: Référendums communaux
classes.disposition_reason: Communal councils may consult their voters (loi communale), including on mergers, but no national register lists these votes; results sit only in individual communes' minutes.

classes.name: Élections à la Chambre des salariés
classes.note: Statutory postal election of the 60 members of the Chamber of Employees by all employees and pensioners, by occupational group, every five years (2008, 2013, 2019, 2024); list PR.

classes.name: Élections aux autres chambres professionnelles
classes.note: Statutory elections of the Chamber of Civil Servants and Public Employees, the Chamber of Commerce, the Chamber of Skilled Trades, and the Chamber of Agriculture by their members, by group; results are published by each chamber.

match.name_pattern: Chambre (des fonctionnaires|de commerce|des métiers|d'agriculture)|Chamber of (Civil Servants|Commerce|Skilled Trades|Agriculture)

classes.name: Grand-Duc
classes.disposition_reason: The head of state is hereditary in the House of Nassau; the government is appointed by the Grand Duke, so no executive is elected.

classes.name: Bourgmestre et échevins
classes.disposition_reason: The mayor is appointed by the Grand Duke and the aldermen by the Minister of the Interior on the proposal of the council majority; voters do not elect them.

classes.name: Conseil d'État
classes.disposition_reason: Its members are appointed by the Grand Duke on the proposal of the government, the Chamber, or the Council itself; there is no public election.

classes.name: Syndicats intercommunaux
classes.disposition_reason: Delegates are designated by the member communes' councils, not chosen at a public election.

classes.name: Magistrats
classes.disposition_reason: Judges are appointed by the Grand Duke (on the proposal of the National Council of Justice since 2023); none is elected by voters.

classes.name: Désignation des candidats
classes.disposition_reason: Parties draw up their lists under their own statutes; the state runs no primary and publishes no nominating vote.

classes.name: Élections sociales (délégations du personnel)
classes.disposition_reason: Held inside each enterprise under labour law, with candidates presented by the unions; they elect workplace delegations, not a public body.

classes.name: Assemblée consultative (1945)
classes.disposition_reason: Appointed after the liberation, from March to August 1945, pending the October 1945 election; no vote was held.
